{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-session-tree-extension Append-only, multi-branch conversation trees for DeepSeek-Harness — a PI-Agent-style SessionTree. The agent's history becomes a tree of immutable nodes, forkable at any historical node, with standard LLM message reconstruction, versioned JSON snapshots,","id":"gh:1348202128","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-session-tree-extension","slug":"robiteame/dsh-session-tree-extension","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-session-tree-extension Append-only, multi-branch conversation trees for DeepSeek-Harness — a PI-"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Agent-style SessionTree. The agent's history becomes a tree of immutable nodes, forkable at any hist"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"orical node, with standard LLM message reconstruction, versioned JSON snapshots,"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-session-tree"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Append-only, multi-branch conversation trees for
DeepSeek-Harness — fork any
historical node, clone "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"a branch into a new session, and browse the whole
lineage as one merged WebUI graph. Old history is "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"never edited or deleted."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Three commands:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Command | What it does |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| `/tree` | Open the merged lineage graph: every non-subagent session and node, clickable and bindab"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"le |
| `/fork` | Branch from any historical node — the fork appears in the graph and as an inline me"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nu under its source session |
| `/clone` | Duplicate the current conversation into an independent ne"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"w session under the same project |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Tree panel (light and dark) with the sidebar's inline fork-branch menu:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The inline `/fork` branch menu beneath its source session:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Published as four npm packages under the `@robiteame` scope:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Package | Role |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `@robiteame/dsh-session-tree` | Carrier Bundle: one install mounts everything below through its co"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"mposition layer |
| `@robiteame/dsh-pi-agent-session-tree` | Host domain service: the `SessionTree`/"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"`SessionTreeStore` domain model and the `sessionTree` Remote |
| `@robiteame/dsh-tool-session-tree` "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"| Command surface: the `/tree` `/fork` `/clone` commands |
| `@robiteame/dsh-client-ui-session-tree`"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" | WebUI tree panel: a native tab in the Harness 0.2 right Sidebar, with an additive overlay fallbac"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"k for older stock builds |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install (users)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### DeepSeek Harness Desktop"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Open **Settings → Plugins → Market**, search for
`@robiteame/dsh-session-tree`, install it, and rest"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"art the desktop app. The
desktop plugin manager activates the carrier bundle, so the next boot compo"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ses
the three rows (`pi-agent-session-tree`, `tool-session-tree`,
`ui-session-tree`) that load the H"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ost service, the commands, and the browser
panel."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"On older desktop builds bundling the `0.2.1-rc.2` CLI, the `dsh plugin`
command only forwards to pnp"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"m and does not activate a newly installed bundle.
Use the in-app market there; after the restart, `/"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"tree` opens the panel."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### CLI (`0.2.1-rc.3` and newer)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"On a CLI that ships the `0.2.1-rc.3` plugin manager, one command installs and
activates the bundle:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Prebuilt tarballs install the same way and need no build scripts:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"After installing, restart the profile. Verify the composed layer:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek-Harness `^0.2.1-rc.2` and Cordis `~4.0.5`; the target
installation provides those "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"peers. The current development and verification
baseline is the published `0.2.1-rc.5` release. No i"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"nstall
scripts run — the tarballs ship prebuilt `lib/` artifacts."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## The three commands"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### `/tree` — open the tree panel"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`/tree` opens the right-side panel as one merged graph for the current
session's lineage: ancestors,"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" forks, and clones appear in a single git-style
view, with user messages, assistant replies, tool ca"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"lls, and model switches
shown as connected nodes. Shared copied prefixes are deduplicated, fork poin"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ts
carry session badges, and the current session's path stays highlighted. Click
a node to bind it; "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"clicking a node owned by another session opens that session
first. Collapse individual subtrees or w"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"hole session branches to focus the
graph."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### `/fork` — branch from any historical node"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`/fork` picks an earlier user prompt and grows a new branch from there: the
conversation continues a"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"long the new path while the original one stays intact.
The fork is created through the official nati"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ve fork API, so it appears in the
session list with real parent linkage. The plugin adds the new bra"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"nch to the
merged graph and also renders it as an inline collapsible menu directly beneath
its sourc"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"e session's row. Both views follow the official reactive session list,
so new branches appear withou"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"row. Both views follow the official reactive session list,
so new branches appear without a refresh."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### `/clone` — duplicate into a new session"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"`/clone` copies the current conversation — through its root path — into an
independent Session under"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" the same project. The source history stays
read-only; the clone is yours to continue separately."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Branch switching and graceful degradation"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The plugin never modifies Harness core files. It capability-detects the
optional branch-selection en"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"gine API at runtime:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **Native mode** — on a checkout carrying
`dev/session-branch-surface.patch`
(`Session.selectMessag"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"eSurface()`), jump/fork switch the model-visible
history directly: the next turn genuinely starts fr"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"om the new branch.
- **Stock mode** — on an unmodified official Harness, the plugin emulates the
swi"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"tch through official append APIs (an empty `replace` surface event) plus a
plugin-owned sidecar unde"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"r `$DSH_HOME/storages/session-tree/` for durable
branch state. The log stays resume-valid.
- **Proje"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ction mode** — if even the emulation is unavailable, navigation moves
the tree projection and panel "},{"id":"p34s7","text":"only, and the next turn keeps the canonical
history."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Every mode is honest about itself: the Host log prints a one-time notice when
a session runs in a no"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"n-native mode. Move the raw `session.jsonl.zstd` between
machines together with the matching sidecar"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ve mode. Move the raw `session.jsonl.zstd` between
machines together with the matching sidecar file."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Append-only** — every node is immutable; branching and jumping only move
the cursor. Old branche"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"s are never edited or deleted.
- **Every entry is a node** — messages, tool calls, model switches, c"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ompaction
records, and branch summaries all become typed nodes; each has a unique
`nodeId` and a `pa"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"rentId` (root is `null`). A node may have multiple
children — that is the fork.
- **Cursor navigatio"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"n** — jumping moves the active leaf to a historical node;
the next append grows a new branch from th"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"ere. Sibling branches stay intact.
- **LLM context** — the model always receives the standard `messa"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"ges` array
for the root→cursor path only."}],"truncated":true}
